Scenario fixture: rgaa-form-button-label-in-name-sources

Each target has a stable id of the form fblins_case_NN. RGAA 11.9.2 covers the buttons inside a <form> or role="form". Its methodology checks that the accessible name contains the visible label, word for word (punctuation and capital letters aside); other sources are not judged.

A. The accessible name does not contain the visible label (FAIL)

01 — FAIL: aria-label that replaces the button text
02 — FAIL: aria-label that replaces an input button's value
03 — FAIL: role="button" in a role="form" element
Rechercher
11 — FAIL: the aria-label leaves out the text in parentheses shown in the button
12 — FAIL: the aria-label holds a visible word with another ending

B. Asked about (CANTTELL)

13 — CANTTELL: one-character visible label, which may be a symbol

C. The accessible name contains the visible label (PASS)

06 — PASS: aria-label that starts with the button text
07 — PASS: accented word kept whole
04 — PASS: a title that does not contain the button text is not judged, since the text gives the name
05 — PASS: an aria-label that loses to aria-labelledby is not judged
Annuler la commande

D. Out of scope (NOT APPLICABLE)

08 — NOT APPLICABLE: the same button outside any form
09 — NOT APPLICABLE: image button, its label is inside the image
10 — PASS: visually hidden text in the label is not part of the visible label
